input.quote: The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years.
input.rationale: In a five-year committed term we have no termination-for-convenience right at all: Section 11.2 allows termination only for uncured material breach or insolvency. Absence of a Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is a deviation; we have added a 30-day convenience right with refund of prepaid fees and confirmed Commerce One has no reciprocal walk-away.

input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Renewals are 12 months (not multi-year) and the non-renewal notice window is 30 days, at our preferred level; Exhibit B pre-agrees the Year 2-5 "and beyond" maintenance and MarketSite fees, so there is no unilateral uplift right to cap. No redline required.
